key_points: People Incorporated rescinded its buyout offer for MGM Resorts, removing a potential premium catalyst.
MGM stock dropped ~9% in after-hours trading following the news.
Earlier reports had indicated MGM CEO openness to a People Inc. bid; the reversal suggests weaker M&A interest.
Recent trading shows MGM underperforming peers and on a five‑day losing streak (~19% down).
Investors await Q3 earnings release on Oct. 28, which could further influence sentiment.
